name: Vyper
typeSystem: Static and strong, with explicit conversions, bounds-checked arithmetic and arrays, and deliberately restricted features: no class inheritance, function overloading, inline assembly, recursion, or unbounded loops. These restrictions are intended to improve auditability.
runtime: Compiled to EVM bytecode, exactly like Solidity, so it runs on the same Ethereum Virtual Machine and is metered by the same gas model.

runtimes.name: EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine)
runtimes.role: Same stack-based VM used by Solidity; Vyper compiles to a different, more auditable subset of EVM bytecode patterns.

compilers.name: vyper
compilers.role: The reference Vyper compiler, emitting EVM bytecode.

concurrencyModel: EVM execution is synchronous within a transaction, but external calls create nested call frames and can re-enter a caller unless protected. Transaction state changes are atomic on success or revert.
